extDescription.message: Updates your Cinepisode progress while you watch Netflix.

optionsIntro.message: Generate this token in Cinepisode: Settings › Auto-tracking (Netflix, Plex...) › Generate my token (the same token works for Tautulli and this extension). Paste it below.

coverage.message: Currently supported: Netflix only. After you watch an episode on a /watch/ page, your progress updates in Cinepisode.
